_readme: Event sources for the GeoID Network importer (importer.js). Probed 2026-10-24: of 48 society, agency and university calendars tried, these returned events (an iCalendar feed, or schema.org Event blocks). Most others build their listing in the browser or refuse bots; add a source by finding its .ics export (Indico: /category/<n>/events.ics; WordPress Events Calendar: ?ical=1) and adding a line.

sources.name: ESA Earth Observation for Society events
